title: File:Flickr - Israel Defense Forces - Constructing the Field Hospital.jpg
author: Israel Defense Forces
description: January 16, 2010. Israel Defense Forces Soldiers constructing the field hospital in Port-au-Prince. Within 8 hours of landing, the IDF field hospital was accepting and treating patients. Israel sent a team of over 250 to help in the rescue and medical efforts after Haiti was struck by a devastating earthquake in January 2010.
